heading: This Afternoon
text: Partly to mostly sunny. Highs from the mid 70s to around 80. Winds variable to southwest at around 5 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Variable clouds. Patches of river valley fog, mainly east of the Greens. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60, except low to mid 60s in the broad valleys west, and around 50 in the cooler hollows east. Winds becoming light, variable to south, except south 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Thursday
text: Mostly to partly sunny after any early fog. Chance of showers and thunderstorms, a rising chance in the afternoon. Highs from the mid 70s to lower 80s. South winds 5 to 15 mph, and gusting to 20 mph, except gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.
